fieldNotes.site: Baldwinsville NY A-B brewery (opened 1983) at 2885 Belgium Rd. Large modern brewery building set back from Belgium Rd in a wooded campus, with extensive trailer drop yards W/SW and rail service.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is a controlled industrial campus set back from the public road. A small checkpoint structure sits at the internal road junction between the trailer yards and the brewery (visible at z18). Internal access road from Belgium Rd splits to employee parking and truck operations. truckGate TRUE.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth-sized structure observed at the internal junction near the brewery/yard interface; A-B breweries operate guarded truck gates as standard. Classified guardShack TRUE, flagged uncertain - booth not resolved at high zoom.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer drop yards W and SW of the brewery in long organized rows, ~200+ trailers, capacity ~340.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks with trailers backed in along the W/N faces of the brewery building; estimated ~38 (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run along the SW edge into the brewery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town setting near Baldwinsville, surrounded by woodland - classified Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal roads and yard aprons leave room to add lanes.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Boxed footprint ~167 acres for brewery core + trailer yards.
